Ruling: representation; project retained. Form 8880 (2025), line 7, "If zero, stop; you can’t take this credit"; line 9, "Note: If line 9 is zero, stop; you can’t take this credit"; p. 2, Credit Limit Worksheet, "But if zero or less, stop; you can’t take the credit—don’t file this form"; p. 2, Who Can Take This Credit, "However, you can’t take the credit if either of the following applies". The reply enters the smaller of lines 10 and 11 and lets each stop show as a zero there (line 7 or line 9 zero makes line 10 zero; worksheet line 3 zero makes line 11 zero). The project takes $0 through f8880.can_take, a nested choose that decides the AGI test first (line 8 within the limit, so line 9 is not zero), then the worksheet, then contributions in a column whose person can take the credit, then line 7 (owner decision 2026-11-07, eligibility AGI-first). It gives the same amount on every completed return: above the limit line 9 is 0.0, with no room line 11 is zero, and with no counted contributions line 6 is zero in both columns, so line 7 is zero. The order changes only which questions are asked and, where line 8 refuses, that the refusal of line 8 is reached before contributions are.
